title: Predicate conformance index
description: Machine-readable manifest of the predicate corpus, so a runner in any language consumes it without parsing prose. Separate from the document-fixture index alongside it: admitting these cases there would have to widen a published enum and a published pattern, which an older validator would reject outright rather than ignore.

spec.description: Relative path to the normative document this corpus is the executable form of.

file.description: Case path relative to this directory. Constrained to cases/ with no path separators in the filename, so an entry cannot reach outside the corpus.

section.description: The section of the predicates README this case pins, so a failure points at the sentence it violates.
